Container.Name: tofa
Container.Overview:
tofa is a media server for your movies and shows. One container runs everything, including its own database and automatic backups. Point it at your media, claim it with your tofa account, and watch on the web, Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Android TV, and Windows.
First start: open http://[your-server]:33333 from a device on your network and sign in to claim the server.
Config note: keep the app data path on a fast pool device (the default below uses /mnt/cache). tofa runs its own database in there; database files on the /mnt/user FUSE layer are slower and not recommended.
tofa is in beta and needs a tofa account. Sign up at https://tofa.tv.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: media server movies tv shows streaming transcoding plex jellyfin alternative
Container.Requires: A tofa account, from https://tofa.tv. x86-64 or ARM64 Unraid host.
Container.License: Proprietary, free to use during beta
Container.Changes:
### 2026-07-30 (0.9.25) - Fixed pixelated playback when converting at Original quality, especially 4K files on NVIDIA systems. - Discover rows can now be added to your home screen from Settings, alongside genre rows. - The Apple TV app can request lossless multichannel FLAC audio or Dolby Atmos when a file includes them.
### 2026-07-29 (0.9.24) - Dolby Vision profile 7 files now play on Apple TV. - FillView finds the real picture inside a letterboxed file, so Zoom to Fill works on baked-in black bars. - Discover rebuilt, with close to thirty lists and one pair of tofa ratings everywhere.
### 2026-07-25 (0.9.23) - Multiple profiles per account, up to 4, each with its own history, watchlist and recommendations. - Parental controls and kids mode, with an age rating limit the server enforces everywhere. - HDR titles now play in the browser without being converted first.
### 2026-07-23 (0.9.22) - Android TV devices that cannot decode a video at full resolution now get a version scaled to what the hardware handles. - Safari is much smoother on big libraries.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: tofa's own data: database, backups, transcode cache, logs. Keep this on a pool (cache) device, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media library. Set Mode to Read Only if tofa should never delete files from disk.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id tofa runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody user, which owns appdata and shares by default.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id tofa runs as. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File-creation mask for files tofa writes.

Config.Name: Hardware transcoding (Intel / AMD)
Config.Description: Leave empty unless you have an Intel or AMD GPU or iGPU. Set both sides to /dev/dri to let tofa use it for hardware transcoding. NVIDIA users leave this empty and instead install the Nvidia-Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters, and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all plus NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,video,utility as variables.

Config.Name: ADVERTISED_LAN_IP
Config.Description: Only needed if you switch the container off host networking (bridge/custom network): set it to your Unraid server's LAN IP so devices at home can connect directly. You can also set this later in the app under Settings > Remote Access. With host networking (the default) tofa detects the address automatically and this can stay empty.
